text: Klein Constantia was acquired in May 2011 by businessmen Zdenek Bakala and Charles Harman; the estate's own history page still describes it as being under their stewardship.
short: Klein Constantia is owned by Zdenek Bakala and Charles Harman.

source.name: Klein Constantia: Our Story
source.quote: In May 2011, the estate is acquired by Zdenek Bakala and Charles Harman, visionary businessmen united by a passion for fine wine and the Constantia Valley.
source.note: Same page (2025 section): 'Under their stewardship, the estate embraces a philosophy of precision...'; the Anwilka property of Hubert de Boüard and Bruno Prats was merged with Klein Constantia a year later.
